description_en: Creates an OTA update package for a device after generating the URL of the OTA update package file by invoking this operation
description_zh: 生成OTA升级包文件的URL后，调用该接口创建设备的OTA升级包
name: CreateOTAFirmware

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OTA update package. The name must be unique within the Alibaba Cloud account and cannot be modified after creation. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and parentheses (()). The name must start with a Chinese character, letter, Japanese character, or digit. The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级包名称，需在阿里云账号下唯一，创建后不可修改。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角圆括号（()），必须以中文、英文、日文或数字开头，长度限制为1~40个字符
parameters.name: firmware_name

parameters.help_en: The version number of the OTA update package. Only letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are supported. The version number must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 当前OTA升级包的版本号，仅支持英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。长度限制为1~64个字符
parameters.name: dest_version

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the OTA update package file, which is the storage address of over-the-air update package file in Object Storage Service (OSS). You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147310.html to generate the URL of over-the-air update package file.

<notice>This parameter is required and can be specified only when the OTA update package contains a single file.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件的URL，即升级包文件在对象存储（OSS）上的存储地址。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147310.html生成升级包文件的URL。

<notice>仅当OTA升级包中添加一个文件时，才可传入此参数，且必须传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: firmware_url

parameters.help_en:
The signature value of the OTA update package file. The value is calculated by applying the SignMethod to the content of over-the-air update package file.

<notice>This parameter can be specified only when the OTA update package contains a single file. If you do not specify this parameter, the MD5 value of over-the-air update package file in OSS is used as the signature value.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件的签名值。使用SignMethod对升级包文件内容加签计算得出的值。

<notice> 仅当OTA升级包中添加一个文件时，才可传入此参数。若不传入，则采用对象存储（OSS）中升级包文件的MD5值作为升级包签名值。
</notice>
parameters.name: firmware_sign

parameters.help_en:
The signature method of the OTA update package. Currently, only MD5 (MD5 signature) is supported.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is MD5
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包签名方法。目前仅支持取值为MD5（MD5签名）。

不传入此参数，默认为MD5
parameters.name: sign_method

parameters.help_en:
The size of the OTA update package file, in bytes.

<notice>This parameter can be specified only when the OTA update package contains a single file. If you do not specify this parameter, the size of the over-the-air update package file in OSS is used.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件的大小，单位：字节。

<notice> 仅当OTA升级包中添加一个文件时，才可传入此参数。若不传入，则采用对象存储（OSS）中升级包文件的大小。
</notice>
parameters.name: firmware_size

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the OTA update package belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The description of the OTA update package. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级包描述。长度不可超过100个字符。一个中文汉字算一个字符
parameters.name: firmware_desc

parameters.help_en:
The type of the OTA update package. Valid values:

0: full update package. The over-the-air update package file contains the complete update package. The full update package is pushed to the device for the update.
1: delta update package. The over-the-air update package file contains only the differences between the new version and the previous version. Only the differences are pushed to the device for the update.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 0
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包类型。可选：

0：整包升级包，您上传的升级包文件包含完整的升级包，将推送整包升级包给设备进行升级。
1：差分升级包，您上传的升级包文件仅包含新版本升级包与之前版本的差异部分，仅推送差异部分给设备进行升级。

不传入此参数，则默认值为0
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the OTA module to be updated, which is the current OTA module version of the device to be updated.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html to view the OTA module version of the device (FirmwareVersion).

If Type is set to 1 (delta update package), this parameter is required, and the value cannot be the same as the current update package version (DestVersion).
If Type is set to 0 (full update package), this parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh:
待升级OTA模块版本号，即待升级设备的当前OTA模块版本号。

可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html，查看设备OTA模块版本号（**FirmwareVersion**）。

Type为1（差分升级包）时，必须传入该参数，且取值不能与当前升级包版本（DestVersion）相同。
Type为0（整包升级包）时，可不传入该参数
parameters.name: src_version

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OTA module. An OTA module represents a different upgradable module of devices under the same product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default module is used, which represents the firmware of the entire device.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186066.html to create a custom OTA module, and call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186532.html to query the OTA modules created under a product
parameters.help_zh:
OTA模块名称。OTA模块是同产品下设备的不同可升级模块。

不传入该参数，则使用default模块，表示整个设备的固件。
可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186066.html创建自定义OTA模块，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186532.html查询产品下已创建的OTA模块
parameters.name: module_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the update package must be verified before a batch update task is created.

true (default): Required.

false: Not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要在创建批量升级任务前通过升级包验证。

true（默认）：需要

false：不需要
parameters.name: need_to_verify

parameters.example: {"ota_notice":"升级底层摄像头驱动，解决视频图像模糊的问题。"}
parameters.help_en:
The custom information to be pushed to the device. The text content format is not restricted. The maximum length is 4,096 characters.

After the update package is added and an update task is created, IoT Platform pushes this custom information to the device along with the update notification
parameters.help_zh:
推送给设备的自定义信息。不限制文本内容格式，长度不超过4096个字符。

添加该升级包完成，并创建升级任务后，物联网平台向设备推送升级通知时，会将该自定义信息下发给设备
parameters.name: udi

fields.help_en:
The MD5 value of the OTA update package file.

This parameter can be specified when the OTA update package contains multiple files. If you do not specify this parameter, the MD5 value of the over-the-air update package file in OSS is used
fields.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件的MD5值。

OTA升级包中添加多个升级包文件时，可传入此参数。若不传入，则采用对象存储（OSS）中升级包文件的MD5值
fields.name: file_md5

fields.help_en:
The name of the OTA update package file. The name must be 1 to 32 characters in length. You can add up to 20 file names, and the names of multiple over-the-air update package files must be unique.

<notice>This parameter is required when the OTA update package contains multiple files.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件名称，长度限制为1~32个字符。支持最多添加20个文件名称，且多个升级包文件的名称不能重复。


<notice> OTA升级包中添加多个升级包文件时，必须传入此参数。
</notice>
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The signature value of the OTA update package file. The value is calculated by applying the SignMethod to the content of over-the-air update package file.

This parameter can be specified when the OTA update package contains multiple files. If you do not specify this parameter, the MD5 value of over-the-air update package file in OSS is used as the signature value
fields.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件的签名值。使用SignMethod对升级包文件内容加签计算得出的值。

OTA升级包中添加多个升级包文件时，可传入此参数。若不传入，则采用对象存储（OSS）中升级包文件的MD5值作为升级包签名值
fields.name: sign_value

fields.help_en:
The size of the OTA update package file, in bytes.

This parameter can be specified when the OTA update package contains multiple files. If you do not specify this parameter, the size of the over-the-air update package file in OSS is used
fields.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件的大小，单位：字节。

OTA升级包中添加多个升级包文件时，可传入此参数。若不传入，则采用对象存储（OSS）中升级包文件的大小
fields.name: size

fields.help_en:
The URL of the OTA update package file, which is the storage address of the over-the-air update package file in Object Storage Service (OSS). You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147310.html to generate a file URL for each over-the-air update package file.

<notice>This parameter is required when the OTA update package contains multiple files.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
OTA升级包文件的URL，即升级包文件在对象存储（OSS）上的存储地址。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147310.html为每个升级包文件生成文件URL。

<notice>OTA升级包中添加多个升级包文件时，必须传入此参数。
</notice>
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The list of OTA update package files
parameters.name: multi_files

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The update package information returned if the call is successful. For more information, see the parameters under Data
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的升级包信息。更多信息，请参见Data下参数描述

FirmwareId.description_en: The ID of the OTA update package, which is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the over-the-air update package
FirmwareId.description_zh: OTA升级包ID，物联网平台为升级包颁发的唯一标识符

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the OTA update package was created, in UTC format
UtcCreate.description_zh: OTA升级包的创建时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the invocation is successful.
true: The invocation is successful, indicating that the OTA update package is created.
false: The invocation fails, indicating that the OTA update package failed to be created
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功，表示OTA升级包创建成功。
false：调用失败，表示OTA升级包创建失败
